description: This Python source file defines the OpenAIResponsesHandler class, which manages processing and applying guardrails to responses and inputs in the OpenAI Responses API format. It includes methods for handling input messages, output responses, streaming responses, and extracting/modifying content with guardrails, specifically tailored for multimodal and structured message formats within a larger guardrail framework.

classes.name: OpenAIResponsesHandler
classes.description: A handler class for processing and applying guardrails to OpenAI Responses API inputs and outputs, supporting structured, multimodal, and streaming message formats.

methods.name: process_input_messages
methods.description: Processes input messages, applying guardrails to string or list-based message inputs, transforming tools, and mapping responses back into the input structure.

methods.name: _extract_and_transform_tools
methods.description: Transforms tools from the Responses API format into a format suitable for guardrail processing.

methods.name: _extract_input_text_and_images
methods.description: Extracts text and image content from input messages for guardrail processing.

methods.name: _apply_guardrail_responses_to_input
methods.description: Maps guardrail responses back into the original input message structure.

methods.name: process_output_response
methods.description: Processes output responses, applying guardrails to text content and tool calls, supporting structured and multimodal outputs.

methods.name: process_output_streaming_response
methods.description: Handles streaming responses, applying guardrails dynamically as responses are streamed.

methods.name: _check_streaming_has_ended
methods.description: Checks if streaming responses have finished.

methods.name: get_streaming_string_so_far
methods.description: Concatenates streamed response texts into a single string.

methods.name: _has_text_content
methods.description: Determines if a response contains any text content to process.

methods.name: _extract_output_text_and_images
methods.description: Extracts text, images, and tool calls from output items for guardrail processing.

methods.name: _apply_guardrail_responses_to_output
methods.description: Maps guardrail responses back into the output response structure.
